functionalReqs: Rank candidate posts for each feed load
Predict several engagement types (like, comment, share, hide)
Respect recency and diversity of authors
hints: One engagement type is not the whole story. How do you combine predictions?
Multi-task model producing P(like), P(comment), P(share), P(hide); a weighted value function on top.

Candidate collection → light first-pass ranker → heavy multi-task neural ranker with user, author, post and context features → value model combining predictions with tunable weights → integrity demotions and diversity rules; train on logged engagement with negative sampling; evaluate with per-task AUC and online A/B on meaningful interactions and retention.
nonFunctionalReqs: Objective aligned with long-term user value
problemStatement: Design the **ranking model for a social news feed**: given a few thousand eligible posts from friends, pages and groups, order them so the user sees what matters most to them.

scaleHints.storage: Billions of engagement events per day

title: Design News Feed Ranking

relatedLectures.title: Design News Feed System : step-1 of 4
